name: @agent-org/plugin-github
description: GitHub as the code host: pull requests, reviews and checks are read and moved through the gh CLI, as the identity the host file names.

agentOrg.description: GitHub: pull requests, reviews and checks.

identity.explanation: The identity of each role: scheduler, workers, managers or reviewer.
identity.breaks: A key that is not a role is refused by name.

edit.why: an object keyed by role: edit one role's key

identity.<role>.breaks: A user-accounts role that names an app is refused, since the app would be ignored.

edit.why: an object: edit one of its keys

identity.<role>.mode.explanation: Whether the role acts as the person's account or as a GitHub App.
identity.<role>.mode.breaks: Any other value is refused by name.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file
edit.dangerous: Switches the role between the person's account and a GitHub App, so its writes are authored as the other identity.

identity.<role>.appId.type: the app's id as GitHub issued it
identity.<role>.appId.explanation: The App's id. Required with github-apps.
identity.<role>.appId.breaks: A missing or malformed id is refused by name, and the role cannot mint its token.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

identity.<role>.keyPath.explanation: The file of the App's private key. The key is never read by this page.
identity.<role>.keyPath.breaks: Required with github-apps. A wrong path means the role cannot mint its token.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file
edit.dangerous: The App's private key file: a wrong path stops the role minting its token, and a key of another App writes as that App.

identity.<role>.installationId.type: the installation's id as GitHub issued it
identity.<role>.installationId.explanation: The installation of the App the token is minted for, when there is more than one.
identity.<role>.installationId.breaks: A malformed id is refused by name.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

identity.<role>.slug.explanation: The App's slug, as its page on GitHub names it. The writes are authored as the slug with [bot].
identity.<role>.slug.breaks: Written with [bot], it is refused by name, since the suffix would be added twice.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

gh.explanation: The routing gh: the folders of the workers' and the leads' accounts, and the leads' workspaces.
gh.breaks: Required. Without it the host file is refused by name.

edit.why: an object: edit one of its keys

gh.workers.explanation: The folder of the workers' gh account.
gh.workers.breaks: A wrong folder sends workers' GitHub calls to the wrong account.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

gh.leads.explanation: The folder of the leads' gh account.
gh.leads.breaks: A wrong folder sends the leads' GitHub calls to the wrong account.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

gh.leadsHeader.explanation: The comment lines at the top of the leads' workspaces file.
gh.leadsHeader.breaks: Each line must be text; the file is rendered from it.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

gh.leadsWorkspaces.explanation: The leads' workspaces, each with the role it plays.
gh.leadsWorkspaces.breaks: Refused by name when an id is not one word.

edit.unit: the units this machine installs for its host file

gh.leadsWorkspaces[].id.breaks: An id with a space is refused by name.

edit.why: a list is changed as a whole: edit tickets.providers.codeHost.gh.leadsWorkspaces

gh.leadsWorkspaces[].role.breaks: A missing role is refused by name.

edit.why: a list is changed as a whole: edit tickets.providers.codeHost.gh.leadsWorkspaces

stack.explanation: Whether doctor requires the gh stack extension for the workers' account, which a worker links a stacked pull request with, and checks that GitHub makes stacked pull requests available to each repository. False leaves both unchecked.
stack.breaks: Any value other than true or false is refused by name. False drops the two checks, so a missing extension is not reported.
